identity.title: Bind authority approval and budget records to execution scope

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Make AuthorityRecord, ApprovalRecord, and BudgetRecord scope-aware using the producer-neutral scope_ref established in 8052-8054, while preserving current semantics for unscoped runs.
human_pressure.why_now: Constraints cannot be evaluated correctly across multi-scope runs if records are only attached to the run container.
do_not_misread: Do not invent hierarchical scope semantics.
Do not change authority, approval, or budget state machines.
Do not infer scope from subject/action strings.

machine_core.goal: Attach optional scope_ref to governance constraint records and project it only from explicit evidence so later rules can avoid cross-scope contamination.
red_lines: Do not change approval approved/denied normalization.
Do not change budget exceeded logic.
invariants: A record without scope_ref retains run-level behavior.
A scoped record belongs only to that explicit scope for later matching.

observable_effect.assertion: Constraint records retain explicit scope_ref without altering existing state derivation.

proofs.assertion: Focused governance tests prove scoped and unscoped records preserve existing state semantics.

failure_semantics: Malformed scope_ref is ignored rather than trusted.
Conflicting scope values are not merged.

steps.title: Add scope_ref to governance records
details: Extend authority, approval, and budget record models with optional opaque scope_ref.

steps.title: Project explicit scope
details: Populate record scope only from contract-supported explicit evidence.

steps.title: Prove unchanged states
details: Verify existing authorized/violation, approved/denied, exceeded/unknown semantics remain identical for unscoped records.

acceptance: Authority, approval, and budget records can carry scope_ref.
Existing governance states and signals remain unchanged in this pack.

must_check: Only optional scope attribution is added.
reject_if: Scope is inferred from producer text or subject/action values.
Authority/approval/budget semantics change beyond scope attribution.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Existing governance suites are the authoritative checks for state semantics while adding scope attribution.
